Andhra Pradesh Temples Generate Revenue Through Mana Mitra Platform

Temples in Andhra Pradesh have generated significant revenue through the Mana Mitra WhatsApp Governance platform. One report indicates that 21 temples earned Rs 12.91 crore in one month using the platform. Another report states that temples collectively earned Rs 22.26 crore with the assistance of Mana Mitra. The platform appears to be facilitating financial gains for religious institutions in the state.
